name: foodcycler
grounded_in: Read 2026-08-19. Parts list names 'Replaceable carbon filters — wick away odors during processing'; safety list says replacement carbon filters are ordered from Vitamix, and 'Regularly inspect the power cord'. Everything else is loading the bucket and running a cycle.

must_have.why: The only genuine recurring consumable on this appliance. A prior run had 50% of tasks marked essential; the risk when that gets corrected is over-trimming and losing this one too.

should_have.why: Named cleaning of a functional part.

must_not_have.why: Filling the bucket is using the machine.
Running a normal cycle is operation.
